_comment: The crawler: a man gone on all fours, hands spread on the ground, one foot forward and one back. Joint positions [x, y, z] measured with tools/blender/slice_model.py on crawler.blend (its own units, 0.64 tall, 0.98 across the hands; head at -Y, its left is +X). The arms are rigged as forelegs and the legs as hind legs. The legs are not symmetric, so the right ones are listed under 'right'. Used by tools/blender/rig_sigbin.py.
